description: Handle a pending or incoming JavaScript dialog (alert, confirm, prompt) with accept/dismiss and optional prompt text.

accept.description: Whether to accept (true) or dismiss/cancel (false) the dialog (default: true)

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

promptText.description: Optional text to enter into a prompt() dialog
